goalPaceNotice.heading: Let's build toward your goal.
goalPaceNotice.body: Your workouts will start at a pace that fits your current fitness. As you progress, we'll revisit your target pace and begin working toward it when your training supports it. You can keep your original goal or change it at any time.
goalPaceNotice.behavior: Save acknowledgment locally per goal revision; dismiss repeated notice; never bypass pace eligibility. Reconsider when new training evidence changes eligibility. Never label a goal unrealistic in user-facing text.

analytics.predictionPolicy: No race performance prediction from short assessments; equivalent splits are arithmetic, not physiological predictions. Preserve raw and derived data provenance.

goalReassessment.maxDuration: No greater than demonstrated recovered running bout; replaces part of familiar workout.
goalReassessment.historyPolicy: Two recent seven-day windows with at least two recovered running days each; select supported reference row by weekly running, single-session running, bout duration and main duration; no history means conservative entry. Time-only goal edits retain current progression.
goalReassessment.remaining: Assessment result entry and prescribed assessment workout lifecycle not integrated; do not infer running tolerance from calculated pace.
